rationale: Figure 11 visibly shows the Mistral 7B multimodal training interface: paired transcriptomes and conversations/questions are tokenized, transcriptome embeddings are transformed by an adapter into Mistral-compatible token-level embeddings, and the result is fed into the Mistral 7B LLM for cross-entropy training. This directly grounds the question+embedding fusion routes, but it does not visibly show the highly-expressed-gene prompt route.
